name: Top Bar to Dock
description:
Move GNOME top bar controls into Ubuntu Dock and reclaim screen space. Access your calendar, notifications, Activities, and background app tray icons directly from the dock. Quick Settings keeps Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, volume, and power controls within reach.

Includes a Show Desktop button, Top/Bottom dock placement, icon size, and icon padding settings. The top bar is hidden while enabled; native controls are restored when disabled.

Requires GNOME Shell 50 and Ubuntu Dock (ubuntu-dock@ubuntu.com). Background app tray icons require an indicator provider such as Ubuntu AppIndicators. This extension does not provide a standalone dock.
